headline: Hearings on five dangerous dog cases and three nuisance dog cases.
summary: Eight hearings involve 15 dogs and their owners, at eight different addresses. Owners include Tyran Daniels and Robert Morat.
items: Dangerous dog hearing for two dogs, Callie and Bella, owned by Tyran Daniels at 58 Cherrelyn St.
Nuisance dog hearing for four dogs, China, Biggie, Cookie and Brady, owned by Anacelis Flecha and Enrick Flecha at 127 Corcoran Blvd
Dangerous dog hearing for a dog named Tatum, owned by Tamara Betancourt at 669 Cooley St.
Dangerous dog hearing for a dog named Deeogee, owned by Cynthia White at 17 Clark St.
Dangerous dog hearing for a dog named Rari, owned by Melyza Rojas at 94 Pearl St apt 3C.
Nuisance dog hearing for two dogs, Ruby and Bear, owned by Shanice Torres at 55 Tyler St.
Dangerous dog hearing for a dog named Russ, owned by Luis Lamoutte at 128 Carver St.
Non-compliance nuisance dog hearing for three dogs, Prince, Diva and Luna, owned by Robert Morat at 150 Elmore Ave.
